## Deferred (decision pending, not counted above)

- `LFENCE`, `MFENCE`, `SFENCE`, `PREFETCHh`, `PREFETCHW`, `CLFLUSH`, `CLFLUSHOPT`, `MOVNTI` — Memory-ordering and cache-control instructions. Usable at ring 3 and GPR/memory based, but not integer arithmetic. Owner decision: does 'general-purpose' scope include them?
- `RDFSBASE`, `RDGSBASE`, `WRFSBASE`, `WRGSBASE` — GPR-only and ring-3 capable, but only if the OS sets CR4.FSGSBASE. Niche; decide with owner.
- `XGETBV`, `RDPID` — Ring-3 feature-detection helpers; borderline 'scalar integer'.

## Excluded (out of scope)

- `AAA`, `AAS`, `AAM`, `AAD`, `DAA`, `DAS`, `PUSHA`, `PUSHAD`, `POPA`, `POPAD`, `BOUND`, `LDS`, `LES`, `SALC` — `invalid-in-64-bit-mode` — INTO is also invalid in 64-bit mode; it is only mentioned on the INT page.
- `IN`, `OUT`, `INS`, `OUTS`, `CLI`, `STI`, `HLT`, `IRET`, `IRETQ`, `SYSRET`, `SYSEXIT`, `RDMSR`, `WRMSR`, `LGDT`, `LIDT`, `LTR`, `INVD`, `WBINVD`, `CLTS` — `privileged` — Representative list. Every system-programming instruction (SDM Vol. 3) is excluded.
- `LFS`, `LGS`, `LSS`, `MOV Sreg` — `segmentation` — Flat segmentation in long mode; revisit only if there is demand.
- `x87 FPU (F*)`, `MMX`, `SSE/SSE2/SSE3/SSSE3/SSE4`, `AVX/AVX2/AVX-512`, `AMX`, `vector AES/SHA/GFNI` — `non-scalar-or-non-integer`
- `XSAVE`, `XSAVEC`, `XSAVEOPT`, `XRSTOR`, `FXSAVE`, `FXRSTOR` — `extended-state`
